user.title: Connect to MAX! Cube Manager
user.description: Enter the app's network hostname from Home Assistant Settings > Apps. Use its full App ID with underscores replaced by hyphens; for example, local-max-cube-manager for a local app.

hassio_confirm.title: MAX! Cube Manager discovered
hassio_confirm.description: Set up the MAX! Cube Manager connected to Cube {serial}?

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the app or read the Cube state. Check the full app hostname and make sure the app is running.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the discovered MAX! Cube Manager app.
abort.invalid_discovery: The app sent invalid connection details.
